title: assure record
description: --commit is the full commit that is checked out. The two suite flags name the results of the two test suites. --predicate names the file to write; it must be outside the checkout. Writes the proof run predicate for the provider to attest, and prints the count of outcomes by result, and the predicate's path, digest, type and signer. Exits 0 when it writes the predicate. Exits 1, and writes nothing, on an unknown or malformed test ID, a commit that is not the full commit checked out, a tree with changes that are not committed, or a job that is not the trusted signer. Exits 2 when a flag is missing or another argument is given.

title: assure gate change
description: --commit is the full commit of the change. --base is the full commit at the head of the branch that the change merges into. The optional tool flag names the specification tool to use, if not the one of the checkout. Prints the decision with every reason. Exits 0 when the change passes and 1 when it is refused. Exits 2, with no decision, when it is called wrongly or cannot decide, such as when the specification has an error at either commit; it then says that no decision was reached, and why.

title: assure gate release
description: --commit is the full commit to release. --predicate names the file for the decision predicate; it must be outside the checkout, and no file may be there already. The optional tool flag names the specification tool to use, if not the one of the checkout. Prints the decision with every reason. After a refused decision it prints one notice line, release refused: N reasons. Writes the decision predicate only when the release passes. Exits 0 when the release passes and 1 when it is refused; a refused release is a neutral outcome of the run. Exits 2, with no predicate, when it is called wrongly, when its output place is refused, or when it cannot decide, such as when the specification has an error at the commit or the job is not the trusted release job at main; it then says that no decision was reached, and why.

title: stego deps
description: Takes no flag and no argument. Resolves the service's modules, writes the module list and its checksums, and prints that they are resolved and must be committed with the application changes.

title: stego build download
description: --source is the source location and --revision its full commit ID. --module is the module path in the source, the top by default. --target is the path of the program to build, in the module. --go is the Go tool of the selected official SDK. --output is a new folder for the module cache. Writes the module cache that the revision needs, with its cache record. All flags but --module are required.

title: stego build
description: --source is the source location and --revision its full commit ID. --module is the module path in the source, the top by default. --target is the path of the program to build, in the module. --go is the Go tool of the selected official SDK, given as a flag, not taken from the archetype. --work is a new private build folder, --output a new result folder and --module-cache the module cache for an offline build. Writes the executable, its build record and both SBOMs into the result folder.

title: stego image build
description: --build-record is the verified build record and --build-record-sha256 its trusted digest. --application is the executable. --trust-store is the explicit CA bundle and --trust-store-sha256 its trusted digest. --entrypoint is the name of the executable in the image, application by default. --output is a new private result folder. Writes the image and its image record into the result folder.

title: stego image sign
description: --image is the folder of a verified image. Signs the image and attaches both SBOMs as attestations, as the provider's trusted signer, and prints the signature references.

title: stego image publish
description: --image is the folder of the image to publish and --build-record its build record. The registry flags name the explicit place of the image in the registry, with no tag; --registry-ca, the registry's CA bundle; and --registry-ca-sha256, its trusted digest. --credentials is a private file with the user name and password. --token-origin and --blob-origin each name one approved secure origin, once per origin. --work is a new private result folder. Pushes the image, reads it back, and writes the image record of what the registry holds into the result folder.

title: stego init
description: --archetype names the archetype and is required; no other argument is taken. Writes a new declaration in the current folder with the smallest example content that checking accepts, and a folder for fills, and prints the project name and each file it created.

title: stego lifecycle supersede
description: Records the successor of a component digest or of a runtime library version, the date after which the old one fails, and whether taking the successor needs a declaration or fill change. Its flags are not decided yet.

title: stego lifecycle withdraw
description: Records that a component digest must not be used any more, with the future date after which it fails. Its flags are not decided yet.

title: qualify-compiler-release.py
description: A release script, not a stego command. --revision is the full lower-case commit ID to qualify. --output is a new result folder whose parent exists. --gh is the absolute path of the hosted CI provider's installed client. Writes the qualification record of the commit into the result folder and prints it.

title: qualify-compiler-release.py --verify-release
description: A release script, not a stego command. --verify-release verifies the release that is already published, as a consumer installs it, in place of a candidate. --revision is the full lower-case commit ID of the release. --output is a new result folder whose parent exists. --gh is the absolute path of the hosted CI provider's installed client. Writes the qualification record, with the verified release, into the result folder and prints it.

title: install-compiler.py
description: An installation script, not a stego command. --revision is the full lower-case commit ID of the release. --output is a new result folder whose parent exists. --gh is the absolute path of the hosted CI provider's installed client. Give --release to download the published release, or --package to install from a folder that holds the release assets. Installs one verified release on Linux amd64: writes the compiler and its build record into the result folder and prints the verified record.

title: stego delivery check
description: --image is the image that the CI provider built, by reference and digest. --record is its build record and --record-sha256 the record's trusted digest. Runs every STEGO check on the image as the last step of each provider's pipeline, prints each check with its result, and exits non-zero when any check fails.

title: stego fill create
description: <name> is the new fill's name. --slot is the slot it fills and is required. --component names the component that owns the slot, when more than one component declares a slot of that name. --collection is the collection the fill is for. Writes the fill and its code in the fills folder, and prints each file it created and what to do next.

title: stego test
description: Runs the tests of every fill and prints their results. Arguments after the command go to the test run. Exits non-zero when a test fails. It records no evidence yet.

title: stego fill sign
description: <name> is the fill to sign off. Signs the fill's current evidence with the person's key, writes the sign-off into the fill's record, and prints it.

title: stego apply
description: Takes no flag. Makes a plan, writes its files and the new record, and prints the plan and that the apply is complete; when the plan changes nothing it prints that and writes nothing. It has no flag to allow a hand edit, no flag to override a pin that does not stand, cannot read a saved plan, and writes no architecture view yet.

title: stego recover
description: Takes no flag and no argument. Completes an interrupted apply, and prints that no pending apply remains.

title: stego plan
description: Takes no flag. Makes a plan and prints the action for each generated file. Today it saves nothing, so apply plans again.

title: stego assets
description: --directory is the frontend build folder, with its index file and assets. --output is the bundle file to write. Both are required. Checks every entry and writes a checked asset bundle.

title: stego fix
description: Rewrites the declaration to the next declaration version that the registry accepts, and prints each construct it cannot rewrite, with its path. With --dry-run it prints the rewrite and writes nothing.

title: stego registry promote
description: <component> is the component in the local registry. --to is a checkout of the common registry. Copies the component into the checkout at its exact digest, at stage alpha, for review, and prints what it copied.
